title: VooPoo Drag X PnP-X Kit
description: Voopoo’s ground-breaking Drag range of vape devices is a superb fusion of everything that makes pod kits and sub-ohm vaping great. The Voopoo Drag X PnP-X Kit combines the simplicity of pod kits with the rich vapour and satisfaction of sub-ohm vaping, in a sleek, stylish and highly portable device. The Drag X 80W mod is powered by a single external 18650 battery (sold separately) which gives you the freedom to swap batteries as needed, or charge in no time at all thanks to a Type-C USB port. Voopoo’s advanced Gene.TT chipset handles an array of safety features as well as intelligent coil recognition which sets the optimum wattage for your coil without you having to adjust any setting – although you can easily do so with the Drag S’s tactile buttons. The Drag X is crowned with the upgraded Voopoo PnP-X 2ml tank, which features an improved airflow system that enhances vapour production and flavour for super-satisfying DL (direct to lung) experience. The tank is top-filling for easy, mess-free refills. The tank is compatible with all of Voopoo’s PnP mesh coils for a near-limitless range of resistances to experiment with. The Drag X PnP-X kit is best used with High-VG e-liquids, particularly long-lasting Shortfills which are available in countless delicious flavours right here at Vapestore. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping. NB: Batteries must be purchased separately - this setup requires 1 x 18650
